[[File:B1UnderwaterDrive-SGtD.png|thumb|right|250px|A B1 battle droid with underwater drive]]

An '''underwater drive''' was a means of locomotion for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to use when submerged in [[Water/Legends|water]]. It was a simple device that expelled water out the back to move the droid.
